comparisons.comparison: Both QCOM and AMD disclose drivers of interest income within their broader investment or other income streams, but they reflect opposite trends in investment balances. QCOM attributes increased interest income to 'higher balances of interest-bearing securities,' whereas AMD notes a decrease in interest income due to 'lower short-term investment balances' despite potentially favorable rates. Additionally, QCOM separately highlights net gains on QSI non-marketable equity investments as a distinct driver, while AMD includes changes in valuation of equity investments as a component of its aggregated 'Other income (expense), net.'
